summary: A candidate who declines an offer courteously and promptly stays in good standing with the recruiter for later.
realLife: A career article advises that gracious, prompt declines protect a reputation with recruiters, who may later work elsewhere, while silence is remembered.
sources: Built In, How to Decline a Job Offer: https://builtin.com/articles/how-to-decline-job-offer
inGame: employer tie that persists after the offer is declined; future job-record event may read it.

turns.summary: The recruiter returns with a better opening.
turns.writesBack: new job lead; employer tie warm

turns.summary: The candidate never replies and is remembered.
The candidate points a friend to the job.
